protocol_status: frozen for the T0--T1-Ogden--T2-Ogden fair comparison; changes require a new schema version
path_policy: all data and model paths are resolved relative to configuration or registry files; no drive letter is part of the scientific definition

time_loss.legacy_runner_role: compatibility only for archived T0/T1-ZL/T2-ZL pipelines; not the frozen chapter-2 fair objective

chapter2_fair_time_loss.peak_metric: RMSE of log(q_model/q_experiment) over complete conditions
chapter2_fair_time_loss.curve_metric: condition-balanced RMSE of normalized nonequilibrium relaxation R_neq
chapter2_fair_time_loss.decade_metric: condition- and decade-balanced RMSE of R_neq
chapter2_fair_time_loss.ordering_metric: fraction of inverted experimental ordering pairs within each loading mode
chapter2_fair_time_loss.total_relaxation_metric: condition-balanced RMSE of normalized total relaxation R
chapter2_fair_time_loss.stress_RMSE_role: reported secondary metric; excluded from parameter selection
chapter2_fair_time_loss.implementation_requirement: the new unified fair-comparison runner must consume this block explicitly; legacy runners are not compliant

joint.representative_rule: minimum fixed-origin distance sqrt(0.5*L_time^2+0.5*L_frequency^2) on the unregularized training Pareto front
joint.q_guardrail: no model-specific hard RMSE threshold in the fair comparison; q magnitude and ordering enter the common time loss
joint.held_out_usage: evaluation only; excluded from search, early stopping and representative selection
joint.amplitude_dma_usage: external diagnostic only; excluded from calibration, early stopping and representative selection
joint.regularization_usage: may stabilize a model-specific optimizer but is excluded from reported prediction loss and final cross-model score

T0.note: bounded weight problem; all time--frequency scalarizations are retained

optimization.budget_comparability_rule: same five seeds and scalarization grid; nonlinear candidates scale with independent parameter dimension; convergence is accepted only after Pareto and best-loss saturation are demonstrated
optimization.budget_saturation_check: repeat with 1.5 times the candidate budget; representative training losses must change by less than 2 percent or the budget is increased again
